components.name: Labeled identity field
components.description: External label, leading identity icon, and clear focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;font-family:'Public Sans Variable','Public Sans',sans-serif}.ds-field label{color:#283d54;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5}.ds-wrap{position:relative}.ds-icon{position:absolute;left:15px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#63788e;pointer-events:none}.ds-field input{width:100%;height:50px;border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:8px;background:var(--background);padding:0 14px 0 44px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;box-sizing:border-box;caret-color:var(--primary)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#63758a;opacity:1}.ds-field input:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#94a9be}.ds-field input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1765ab1a;outline:none}.ds-field input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--destructive)}.ds-field input:disabled{opacity:.5;background:#8091a580}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-field input{font-size:16px}.ds-field input::placeholder{font-size:12px}}

components.name: Demo role choice
components.description: Outlined role selector; pressed state adds blue border and check indicator.
components.css: .ds-role{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-height:67px;padding:13px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--background);color:#48657f;text-align:left;font-family:'Public Sans Variable','Public Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 150ms ease,background 150ms ease}.ds-role span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.ds-role strong{color:#253d55;font-size:12px;font-weight:550}.ds-role small{color:#65758a;font-size:10px}.ds-role:hover:not(:disabled){background:#f4f8fc;border-color:#86abd0}.ds-role[aria-pressed=true]{background:#eff6fc;border-color:var(--primary)}.ds-role:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #2780c7;outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-role{transition-duration:.01ms}}

narrative.overview: Waypoint uses the approved navy and blue identity, Public Sans, precise borders, and restrained corners. The implemented interface puts readable task controls on light surfaces and uses the navy brand surface for recognition and context. This document records the current sign-in portal and role landing scaffolds; it does not imply a completed operational component library.
keyCharacteristics: Navy brand context with lighter supporting text.
Labeled icons and visible keyboard focus.
dos: Do reuse Public Sans and the navy/blue identity.
Do keep labels, messages, and icons alongside meaningful state colors.
Do preserve visible focus and the mobile input size.
Do document demo and scaffold boundaries clearly.
donts: Don't substitute a new palette or decorative font for the approved identity.
Don't treat the lifecycle diagram as navigation or live delivery status.
Don't describe unimplemented operational components as established patterns.
